summary: MetaVia Inc. filed an 8-K on July 2, 2026, regarding a prospectus supplement for an at-the-market offering of up to $4,000,000 of common stock under an existing Sales Agreement with Ladenburg Thalmann. This is a routine capital-raising activity, not a special situation. The filing includes a legal opinion on share validity. As an ordinary shelf takedown with no transformative corporate event, no deal terms or strategic change apply.
